Subphases are included in the integration total. Observer diagnostics, when enabled, overlap integration and other evolution work; do not add them to the total. Assembly includes preparation. Timings describe this run, not simulated time.

Every frame comes from the C++ assembler and solver. Straight P1 triangles; degree-six assembly quadrature; degree-eight error integration. Surface and nodal-error views use the same P1 interpolation. Error norms compare against the continuous exact formula when one is available; dashes indicate no analytical reference. These examples validate selected smooth problems, not arbitrary PDE stability.
